justifications.type_expressiveness: Solid enums for Expr/Value/BinOp/UnaryOp/EvalError, but TypeError carries a String message instead of a structured variant capturing operator and operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with three meaningful variants and disciplined Result use; a couple of from_utf8().unwrap() calls and an unreachable! are present without explicit justifying comments.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with doc comments on all public items, manual Display/Debug for errors, Display for Value, and consistent naming.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and clean recursive descent, but uses if/else chains where match would be cleaner and clones identifier strings rather than borrowing during parsing/evaluation.
